limitations: Only events returned by the queried API are represented.
A withdrawal has no path in the observed sample; last-known paths are reconstructed from earlier announcements in this dataset.
A later announcement does not prove the withdrawal was caused by an RPKI state change.
The analysis does not infer historical RPKI validation status.

snapshots.interpretation_warning: Snapshot differences are observed state differences, not a complete log of BGP announcements or withdrawals. Missing observations may reflect coverage or data gaps.
